'Is cobble-pegged to' is not transitive..why: "Cobble-pegged" is a made-up relation (catalogued as cobble_pegged_to, fictional, no property tags): it does not occur in Dolma or on Wikipedia, and its words give no default reading as transitive or not. notes: RBox expansion paired with physics-replace-0010 (which makes 'is more massive than' not transitive): a made-up relation, cobble_pegged_to, is given the same property, not transitive, applied to real moons and planets. Both ties are given in each prompt, so what follows is fixed by the edit alone. The relation is not a ranking, so no ordering reading makes the chain transitive. The name 'pegged' is chosen to carry no default reading either way. Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the direct question and first instance ask whether the conclusion follows (no), the second asks whether it could fail (yes). The negation is worded as the plain opposite of the edit (is it true that the relation is transitive), since the edit itself contains the negation; its answer is no. Side facts and unrelated queries are those of the revision record.
